title: Pearly-white saucer seen on closed-circuit feed at Cape Canaveral
place_text: Cape Canaveral Air Force Station, Florida (feed location unknown)

tellings.quote: But there's a saucer 20 ft across. It was sort of like a modified egg.

plain: In 1992, at Cape Canaveral Air Force Station in Florida, a pearly-white saucer about 20 feet across showed up on a closed-circuit video feed. Greg Rogers, a NASA doctor, tells Michels he saw it himself and describes it as "sort of like a modified egg." He does not say where the feed was coming from, and if he is right, a craft like that was being kept somewhere watched by cameras.
